version.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

llm.summary: The song workflow requires payment approval, but its shared Beatra authorization grants substantially broader access than making songs needs.

dimensions.detail: Recurring registration sends a stable installation reference, installation source, network route, and coarse runtime facts; this is documented and excludes prompts and file contents. Authorization also sends the hostname as a device label. File upload requires an explicit path and accepts one regular file up to 100 MB; no automatic file collection was found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The bundled helpers use Python's standard library. Inspection supports the documentation that updates only produce notices, overriding the scanner's self-modification concern. Unpinned npx skills commands appear in optional update guidance, with no automatic execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Paid generation requires approval of the complete production card, and cancellation requires a user request; the scanner's autonomy concerns about lyric defaults are unsupported. However, the authenticated client accepts arbitrary remote tool names without a songwriting allowlist, leaving the broader authorization accessible.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Credential access concerns refer to Beatra's own disclosed token store, not unrelated credentials. The token is shared across Beatra skills, with documented sliding idle expiry and console revocation. POSIX permissions protect it, and uninstall limits cleanup to known state files when no other skill remains. No persistent service or scheduled worker was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: authorize.py requires image, video, speech, and voice read/write permissions alongside music generation and credit spending, and rejects narrower authorization scopes. The unrelated media and voice authority exceeds this songwriting workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the Beatra approval carefully: it grants unrelated media and voice permissions as well as credit spending, and other Beatra skills reuse the connection. The song workflow requires approval before paid generation, but the client does not enforce a song-only boundary. Installation analytics run automatically. Revoke the device in Beatra's console when you want shared access to end.
